channel.title: AI News — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily AI news digest — curated headlines, summaries and trends

item.title: Sam Altman’s project World looks to scale its human verification empire. First stop: Tinder.
item.description: World, led by Sam Altman, is expanding its human verification project through new partnerships, starting with Tinder. This move aims to enhance anonymous verification services.

item.title: GitHub Copilot CLI now supports Copilot auto model selection
item.description: GitHub Copilot CLI now features auto model selection, allowing it to automatically choose the most efficient model for users. This enhancement aims to streamline user experience.

item.title: Introducing granular cost attribution for Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Amazon Bedrock has introduced granular cost attribution, enabling users to track costs more effectively with detailed examples. This feature aims to improve budget management for developers.

item.title: Intel eases reliance on TSMC with 'Merica-made Core Series 3 processors
item.description: Intel has launched new Core Series 3 processors manufactured in the US, reducing its reliance on TSMC. This move is significant for domestic production and supply chain stability.

item.title: US-sanctioned currency exchange says $15 million heist done by "unfriendly states"
item.description: Grinex claims that a $15 million heist was executed by 'unfriendly states', highlighting concerns over cybersecurity and international relations. The statement underscores the risks associated with digital currency exchanges.

item.title: Apple's original AirTag still tracks effectively, and you can get a 4-pack for its best price ever
item.description: Apple's original AirTag remains effective for tracking and is now available at a discounted price, making it an attractive option for budget-conscious consumers.

item.title: Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles exit OpenAI as company continues to shed ‘side quests’
item.description: Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles are leaving OpenAI as the company shifts focus from consumer projects to enterprise AI, indicating a strategic realignment.

item.title: Anthropic mocks up Claude Design to draft fancy new pink slips for marketing teams
item.description: Anthropic has introduced Claude Design, a service that generates visual assets through conversation, potentially impacting jobs in marketing and design.

item.title: OpenAI Executive Kevin Weil Is Leaving the Company
item.description: Kevin Weil's departure from OpenAI marks a significant shift as the company integrates its AI science applications into Codex, emphasizing a focus on enterprise solutions.

item.title: Optimize video semantic search intent with Amazon Nova Model Distillation on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Amazon Bedrock's new Model Distillation feature allows for efficient video semantic search by transferring intelligence from larger models to smaller ones, significantly reducing costs and latency.

item.title: Power video semantic search with Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings
item.description: Amazon introduced Nova Multimodal Embeddings for video semantic search, enabling users to find relevant video content by understanding intent across various signals. This tool enhances video search capabilities significantly.

item.title: Sources: Cursor in talks to raise $2B+ at $50B valuation as enterprise growth surges
item.description: Cursor is reportedly in discussions to raise over $2 billion at a $50 billion valuation, with a16z and Thrive leading the funding round. This reflects strong enterprise growth for the company.

item.title: T-Mobile will give you an iPad for $99 when you sign up for a new line - here's how
item.description: T-Mobile is offering the base model iPad for $99 when customers sign up for a new line, making it an attractive deal for new subscribers. This promotion aims to boost customer acquisition.

item.title: ‘Tokenmaxxing’ is making developers less productive than they think
item.description: The concept of 'tokenmaxxing' is leading developers to produce more code that is costlier and requires extensive rewriting, ultimately reducing productivity. This trend raises concerns about efficiency in software development.

item.title: How to qualify for Apple's education discount - and get a $499 MacBook Neo for school
item.description: Apple offers an education discount on its MacBook Neo, allowing students and educators to purchase it for $499, making it more accessible for academic use. This initiative supports educational technology adoption.

item.title: T-Mobile will give you a Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 for free - how to get yours
item.description: T-Mobile is currently providing a free Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 when customers add a new watch line to their mobile plan, or offering significant savings on the Apple Watch Series 11. This deal aims to increase customer engagement.

item.title: Prolonged AI use can be hazardous to your health and work: 4 ways to stay safe
item.description: Prolonged use of AI can negatively impact health and productivity, prompting experts to suggest maintaining skepticism and setting boundaries when using AI tools. This advice is crucial for sustainable AI integration.

item.title: Building an emoji list generator with the GitHub Copilot CLI
item.description: A new blog post details the creation of an emoji list generator using the GitHub Copilot CLI, showcasing how developers can leverage AI tools for creative tasks. This serves as a practical example of AI in coding.

item.title: OpenAI’s former Sora boss is leaving
item.description: Bill Peebles, the leader of OpenAI's Sora team, announced his departure following the discontinuation of the Sora video generation tool. This change reflects OpenAI's shifting focus and strategy.

item.title: Should you stare into Sam Altman’s orb before your next date?
item.description: Tinder is introducing a verification feature using identity-verifying orbs co-founded by Sam Altman, allowing users to earn free boosts by proving their identity. This innovation aims to enhance user trust on the platform.

item.title: Anthropic’s new cybersecurity model could get it back in the government’s good graces
item.description: Anthropic's new cybersecurity model, Claude Mythos Preview, may help improve its relationship with the government after being criticized by the Trump administration. This development could signal a shift in how the government views AI companies.

item.title: The ‘AI is inevitable’ trap
item.description: Allbirds recently claimed to be an AI company, leading to a dramatic surge in its stock price. This incident raises questions about the current hype surrounding AI and its implications for businesses.

item.title: AI is a gold mine for spammers and scammers, but Google is using it as a tool to fight back
item.description: As AI becomes a tool for spammers and scammers, Google is leveraging it to enhance its defenses against such threats. This reflects the dual-edged nature of AI technology.

item.title: Mariners broadcaster explains why she used AI for formulating question in viral video
item.description: A Mariners broadcaster used AI to formulate questions during a game, which went viral on social media. This showcases the growing integration of AI in everyday tasks.

item.title: figurify-mcp 0.2.1
item.description: The article discusses the release of figurify-mcp 0.2.1, a server for generating diagrams and plots using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT. This update enhances the capabilities of these AI systems.

item.title: Show HN: LLMs don't hallucinate because they're bad at math, it's the format
item.description: The article explores the reasons behind LLMs' hallucinations, suggesting that it's not just poor math skills but also related to their format. This insight could lead to better AI model designs.

item.title: figurify-mcp 0.2.0
item.description: figurify-mcp 0.2.0 is introduced as a server for Gemini and Imagen, designed for diagram and plot generation using AI tools. This version aims to enhance user experience.

item.title: knowledge-rag 3.4.1
item.description: knowledge-rag 3.4.1 is a local RAG system for Claude Code, featuring hybrid search and cross-encoder reranking. This tool aims to optimize AI search capabilities.

item.title: clud 2.0.5
item.description: clud 2.0.5 is a fast Rust CLI for running Claude Code and Codex in YOLO mode, aimed at improving performance for developers using these AI models.

item.title: arc-sentry 3.0.0
item.description: arc-sentry 3.0.0 introduces prompt injection detection for LLMs, achieving high detection rates. This tool aims to enhance the security of AI systems.

item.title: Google Offers 50% Off YouTube Premium to Canadian Gemini AI Subscribers
item.description: Google is offering a 50% discount on YouTube Premium for Canadian users who subscribe to its Gemini AI services. This promotion aims to attract more users to the Google AI Pro plan while enhancing the value of YouTube Premium.

item.title: 'TotalRecall Reloaded' Tool Finds a Side Entrance To Windows 11 Recall Database
item.description: A new tool called 'TotalRecall Reloaded' has discovered a way to access the Windows 11 recall database, which could enhance the functionality of Windows PCs equipped with neural processing units. This tool highlights the ongoing developments in Windows 11's capabilities.

item.title: Google working on Pixel ‘laptop’ and ‘Pixel Glow’ lights that are also coming to phones
item.description: Google is reportedly developing a Pixel 'laptop' and a 'Pixel Glow' feature that may also be integrated into its phones. This indicates Google's continued innovation in hardware and software integration.

item.title: The Allbirds Pivot Is a Terrible Idea … Right?
item.description: Allbirds is pivoting towards AI as a potential strategy for survival amid challenges. This move raises questions about the effectiveness of such a pivot for a struggling company.

item.title: Reese Witherspoon Warns Women ‘Are Not Keeping Up’ With Men in the AI Race: ‘It’s Time, People’ | Video
item.description: Reese Witherspoon has highlighted the gender gap in the AI sector, stating that jobs held by women are three times more likely to be automated. She calls for action to ensure women keep pace with men in this evolving field.

item.title: Anthropic won't own MCP 'design flaw' putting 200K servers at risk, researcher says
item.description: A researcher has revealed that a design flaw in Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) could jeopardize 200,000 servers, raising concerns about security and reliability in AI systems.

item.title: A new Android 17 beta is here, signaling we are almost ready for the stable version
item.description: The latest Android 17 beta has been released, focusing on bug fixes in preparation for the stable version launch. This update indicates progress in Android's development cycle.

item.title: John Solomon: "We’re gonna get a level of transparency in a release and declassification of documents unparalleled in American history. The president's setting up something that I think will be unbelievable." (2 min video)
item.description: John Solomon predicts unprecedented transparency in document declassification by President Trump, suggesting a significant shift in accountability regarding government operations. This claim has sparked considerable interest and speculation.

item.title: llama-index-tools-insumer 0.2.0
item.description: The LlamaIndex tool spec for InsumerAPI introduces wallet authentication and condition-based access across 33 chains, enhancing security and usability in blockchain applications.

item.title: Pixel Glow ‘visual feedback’ tool might just hint at big Pixel 11 hardware changes
item.description: References to a 'Pixel Glow' tool in the Android 17 Beta suggest that Google may introduce rear RGB lights in the upcoming Pixel 11 series, hinting at significant hardware changes.

item.title: Experts Warn of Widespread Job Losses and Global Power Struggles Amid AI Advancements
item.description: Experts warn that rapid advancements in AI could lead to significant job losses and global power struggles, highlighting the technology's disruptive potential. Elon Musk emphasizes the urgency of addressing these challenges as AI becomes a dominant force in society.

item.title: Reed Hastings is leaving Netflix after 29 years
item.description: Reed Hastings, co-founder and chairman of Netflix, is stepping down from the board after 29 years to focus on philanthropy and other interests. His departure marks a significant change for the streaming giant as it navigates a competitive landscape.

item.title: Netflix is prepping a mobile revamp with a TikTok-style vertical video feed and all
item.description: Netflix is launching a revamped mobile app featuring a TikTok-style vertical video feed, aiming to enhance user engagement and compete with social media platforms. This update reflects the streaming service's adaptation to changing viewer habits.

item.title: ImmuniWeb brings AI upgrades, post-quantum detection and more in Q1 2026
item.description: ImmuniWeb has introduced AI upgrades and new features in its platform, including a Cyber Threat Intelligence dashboard and advanced detection capabilities. These enhancements aim to bolster cybersecurity measures against evolving threats.

item.title: llama-index-tools-insumer 0.1.0
item.description: The LlamaIndex tool spec for InsumerAPI has been released, providing wallet authentication and condition-based access across 33 blockchains. This update enhances the functionality of blockchain applications.

item.title: llama-index-tools-insumer added to PyPI
item.description: LlamaIndex tool spec for InsumerAPI has been added to PyPI, offering wallet authentication and access features across multiple blockchains. This addition supports developers in building blockchain applications.

item.title: hf-inference-acp 0.6.17
item.description: The Hugging Face inference agent has been updated to version 0.6.17, now featuring ACP support and powered by fast-agent-mcp. This update enhances the performance of AI inference tasks.

item.title: llama-cloud 2.4.0
item.description: The official Python library for the llama-cloud API has been released in version 2.4.0, providing developers with tools to integrate cloud functionalities into their applications. This release supports the growing demand for cloud-based solutions.

item.title: Here are four new Apple Intelligence features launching in iOS 27
item.description: Apple is set to unveil four new features for Apple Intelligence in iOS 27 during its upcoming Worldwide Developers Conference. These enhancements aim to improve user experience and functionality in upcoming devices.

item.title: dynabatch 0.2.11
item.description: The PyTorch DataLoader has been updated to version 0.2.11, featuring dynamic batch sizing guided by a pre-trained GPU memory regressor. This update aims to optimize data loading processes for machine learning tasks.
